question:
Study the given diagram carefully, and answer the question asked. The numbers given in different parts represent the number of persons.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fcbae0bf198821e4010c9fbea7e2587d7b6189f9a2081ebb47bc52627e4f3624.png] 

Boys

Athletes

College Students

How many boys are there who are college students and athletes as well?
solution:
According to the Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb61ed6c9ef3fb31f5960de56d331cdaa07cd25cdfe2789abe7364be8aad164f.png] 

The shaded area shows the total number of boys who are college students as well as athletes

So, the total number of boys who are athletes and college students are **'9'**

Hence the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
